name: Goto 10 Retro
description: All things Atari (consoles, 8-bit computers and the ST) plus Apple, Commodore and other retro favorites.

name: Greg Buchanan
description: Greg Buchanan is a game writer and narrative designer (Until Dawn, The Dark Pictures, Metro) and novelist. His newsletter covers video game storytelling, with reflections, analysis and writing exercises from a working writer's perspective.

name: Grid Sage
description: Writing about video games from Grid Sage

name: Hailing From The Edge
description: Writing about video games from Hailing From The Edge

name: Hardcore Gaming 101
description: Hardcore Gaming 101 is a long-running site publishing in-depth reviews and histories of video games, with a strong emphasis on older, Japanese and obscure titles across many platforms.

name: Harris Powell-Smith
description: Personal site and blog of Harris Powell-Smith, a narrative designer and writer of interactive fiction for Choice of Games, including the Crème de la Crème series. Posts cover interactive fiction craft and advice alongside their own projects.

name: Have You Played?
description: Adrian Hon's blog, where the Have You Played? series now lives. Hon is a game designer (Zombies, Run!) and author who writes essays on recent games, puzzle design, larps and immersive experiences.

name: Have You Played? (Substack)
description: The original Substack home of Adrian Hon's Have You Played? newsletter, with essays on recent games and how to think about them, written for a general audience and avoiding industry news.

name: Heather Flowers
description: Newsletter from indie developer Heather Flowers with updates on the games she is making, including demos and previews of upcoming projects.

name: Hello Loops
description: Hello Loops covers cozy and casual games, with reviews, demo impressions, upcoming release notes and curated recommendation lists.

name: Hercozygaming
description: Her Cozy Gaming is Wendy England's blog of cozy game lists and reviews, covering life sims, story-driven and organisation games, with seasonal picks and short-session recommendations.

name: I Play Games So You Don't Have To
description: Long-form write-ups of every game the author finishes, ranked at year's end, alongside essays and weekly notes on releases and what they are playing.

name: IGW Games
description: IGW Games is the site of a software engineer and homebrew developer making new games and tools for retro consoles such as the NES and Nintendo E-Reader.

name: Ian Plays
description: I love tinkering with old computer hardware, and have a mostly working collection of many old and current consoles and computers.

name: Ignition Facility
description: Community-driven go-to-market strategy and support for games. And some shitposting, probably.

name: Indie Game Picks
description: Indie Game Picks is run by Nikolis (Zaratoth) and Mary (Zozoulini), who recommend indie games they have played and highlight promising crowdfunding titles, with a leaning toward retro-styled games.

name: Indie Notebook
description: I make indie games and comic strips, this is my public notebook.

name: Indie Story Games
description: An indie gaming blog focused on games with stories to tell and the developers behind them

name: Indie Tsushima
description: Indie Tsushin is an English and Japanese site from Nice Gear Games introducing indie games and developers from Japan.

name: Indieformer
description: Indieformer is a small Australian indie game publisher run by Josh and Clem. Their newsletter discusses the publishing process openly, from scouting prototypes to launch.

name: Indielike
description: Spiraling thoughts on video games, film, and culture.

name: Indigenous GameDevs
description: Indigenous Game Devs is an independent and self-determined, grassroots community of Indigenous people working in video game development and academia from around the world.

name: Infinite Backlog
description: Simon K Jones's irregular journal of working through a backlog of games, films, comics, music and books, with his reactions to each.

name: Infinite Lives
description: Infinite Lives is a journalistic newsletter by Harrison Polites covering the games industry with an Australian focus, offering news analysis, explainers and interviews written to be accessible to non-gamers.

name: Interplay of Light
description: Interplay of Light is a technical blog by a lead rendering engineer (formerly at Rare, Blitz and Playground Games) about real-time computer graphics and rendering performance in games.

name: Jagger Byte
description: Jagger Byte is the Substack of David Jagneaux, a former games journalist (IGN, UploadVR, PC Gamer) now working in game design, XR consulting and communications, writing about games he is playing and the industry.

name: Jake Should Be Writing
description: Jake Steinberg, a writer and university professor, close-reads games through a narrative and craft lens and examines games culture and criticism.

name: Jank
description: Jank is an independent, reader-supported arts and culture website about PC games, publishing news, reviews, interviews and analysis. It is written by Jon Hicks, Brendan Caldwell and Graham Smith, veterans of Rock Paper Shotgun, PC Gamer and Eurogamer.

name: Johto Times
description: Johto Times is a Pokémon newsletter focused on opinion, personal memories and nostalgia, with interviews from the Pokémon fan community and an interest in preserving the history of early fandom.

name: Just One More Turn
description: Just One More Turn is written by a PhD scientist and gamer at the intersection of video games and science, summarising research that uses games and sharing impressions of games played.

name: Keith Burgun Games
description: Writing about video games from Keith Burgun Games

name: Kenneth Dunlop's Game Dev Blog
description: Welcome to the blog. I’m Kenneth Dunlop, game designer and solo indie dev for Plasma Beam Games.

name: Kevin Velazquez
description: Writing about video games from Kevin Velazquez

name: Kimimi The Game-Eating She-Monster
description: Kerry Brunskill's reader-supported blog of enthusiastic write-ups on games old and new, with a strong focus on Japanese and retro titles across many platforms

name: Late to Gaming
description: Late To Gaming is a personal Blogger site logging what the author is playing, with first impressions, completed-game write-ups, retro reviews and game lists.

name: Late to the LAN Party
description: Late to the LAN Party is Peter Monks's free newsletter of reminiscences and deep dives into the games he has played over the decades, looking at what makes them work artistically and technically, with occasional detours into animation and film.

name: Laura Michet
description: Personal blog of Laura Michet, a writer, editor and narrative designer at Blendo Games. Short daily posts cover games played and made alongside cycling, travel, films and other interests.

name: Leeks Cosy Corner
description: Leeks Cosy Corner is Krista's blog sharing thoughts, reviews and recommendations on video games, especially cosy, life-sim and indie titles, alongside music, books, Pokémon TCG and LEGO.

name: Legends of Localization
description: Legends of Localization, by professional translator Clyde Mandelin, takes a detailed look at how video games change in translation and why, with side-by-side comparisons and articles on localisation history.

name: Libertea
description: Libertea is a one-person Substack of occasional opinion pieces about video games and the industry around them.

name: Liu
description: Liu writes from experience in game marketing and production, helping indie studios get games made and find players, including conversations with industry figures about studio sustainability.

name: Load Last Save
description: Load Last Save is Roger Renfro's heavily opinionated, joke-filled video game reviews focused on mechanics and gameplay, favouring challenging arcade-style, action and indie games.

name: Lorien Accelerator
description: Blog of Lorien Accelerator, an Istanbul-based accelerator programme for seed-stage game studios and game tech companies, publishing insights and advice for developers on building and scaling studios.

name: Lost Video Games
description: Lost Video Games is Michael Honore's blog rounding up the week's video game news and releases, with some entertainment news and personal opinion.

name: Lunatic Obscurity
description: Lunatic Obscurity reviews obscure and little-known video games, particularly Japan-only releases, across a wide range of retro consoles, computers and arcade hardware.

name: Maddy The Game Traveller
description: Maddy, an Australian game maker and player, shares play diaries and detailed personal reflections on the games she is working through, such as a multi-part Persona 5 Royal journal.

name: Magnvs' RPG Journey
description: Magnvs' RPG Journey traces the history and evolution of video game RPGs and their subgenres across periods, platforms and regions, with attention to design trends, art direction and cultural references.

name: Maister's Graphics Adventures
description: Maister's Graphics Adventures is a low-level graphics programming blog covering Vulkan, emulation, rendering and latency measurement, written by the developer behind projects such as Granite and PyroFling.

name: Mana Mode
description: Mana Mode is an RPG and JRPG blog from a casual gamer focused on mindful, pressure-free play, with relaxed reviews, quest-log reflections and guides.

name: Margot Plays Video Games
description: Site no longer exists
